title: Lower Wanted Level
effect: Removes one wanted star each time you enter it.

title: Raise Wanted Level
effect: Adds one wanted star each time you enter it.

title: Give Weapons
effect: Adds a full set of weapons with ammo to your weapon wheel.

title: Explosive Ammo
effect: Every bullet you fire explodes on impact.

title: Flaming Bullets
effect: Bullets set targets and vehicles on fire.

title: Explosive Melee Attacks
effect: Punches and kicks cause a small explosion on contact.

title: Slow-Motion Aim
effect: Slows time while you aim down sights.

title: Super Jump
effect: Lets you jump several stories high from a standstill.

title: Fast Run
effect: Your character sprints much faster on foot.

title: Fast Swim
effect: Your character swims much faster on the surface and underwater.

title: Skyfall
effect: Teleports you high into the air and drops you in freefall.

title: Give Parachute
effect: Puts a parachute on your back.

title: Moon Gravity
effect: Lowers gravity so people, cars and objects float when they leave the ground.

title: Change Weather
effect: Cycles to the next weather type, from clear skies through rain, fog and storms.

title: Slippery Cars
effect: Removes most tire grip so every car slides like it is on ice.

title: Slow Motion
effect: Slows down the whole game, including you.

title: Drunk Mode
effect: Your character stumbles and the camera sways as if drunk.

title: Invincibility
effect: Makes you immune to bullets, explosions, falls and fire for a limited time.

title: Max Health and Armor
effect: Refills your health bar and gives you full body armor.

title: Recharge Special Ability
effect: Fills the special ability meter of the character you are playing.

title: Spawn Buzzard
effect: Spawns a Buzzard attack helicopter with mounted guns and missiles.

title: Spawn Comet
effect: Spawns a Comet sports car in front of you.

title: Spawn Rapid GT
effect: Spawns a Rapid GT sports car in front of you.

title: Spawn Stretch Limo
effect: Spawns a long stretch limousine.

title: Spawn Trashmaster
effect: Spawns a garbage truck.

title: Spawn Sanchez
effect: Spawns a Sanchez dirt bike.

title: Spawn PCJ-600
effect: Spawns a PCJ-600 street motorcycle.

title: Spawn BMX
effect: Spawns a BMX bicycle.

title: Spawn Duster
effect: Spawns a Duster, an old crop duster biplane.

title: Spawn Stunt Plane
effect: Spawns a Mallard stunt plane.

title: Spawn Caddy
effect: Spawns a golf cart.

title: Spawn Dodo
effect: Spawns a Dodo seaplane.
note: Phone only. In GTA V this only works after you unlock it in the story.

title: Spawn Duke O'Death
effect: Spawns the armored Duke O'Death muscle car.
note: Phone only. In GTA V this only works after you unlock it in the story.

title: Spawn Kraken
effect: Spawns the Kraken submarine.
note: Phone only. In GTA V this only works after you unlock it in the story.

title: Director Mode
effect: Opens Director Mode for recording scenes.
